user_query: I want to know the top-ranked restaurants in San Francisco including names, addresses, ratings, photos, and Google Maps URLs.

TaskList.description: Search for top-ranked restaurants in San Francisco.
Retrieve additional information for each restaurant, including addresses and ratings based on the results from Subtask 1.
Fetch photos of each restaurant using the names obtained from Subtask 1.
Get Google Maps URLs for each restaurant using their names.
